bifrost: springboard/src/media/hwdec/ (libavcodec + VA-API decode), springboard/src/media/convert.rs (NV12 to RGBA), springboard/src/gpu/nv12.rs (NV12 dma-buf import), springboard/src/shell/video.rs (consumer)
summary: BifrOSt decodes H.264 and HEVC in hardware (VA-API through libavcodec, software fallback) and converts NV12 to RGBA for the shell, but only inside the media stack. No app-facing SDK API exists, and there is no compression session, encoder, pixel transfer, rotation, RAW, HDR metadata or frame processing.

features.bifrost: springboard/src/media/hwdec/ffmpeg.rs (Decoder, impl VideoDecoder), springboard/src/media/mod.rs (VideoDecoder trait, line 226)
features.note: H.264 and HEVC only, behind the VideoDecoder trait; no SDK type is exposed to apps

features.bifrost: springboard/src/media/hwdec/vaapi.rs (libva probe on the DRM render node)
features.note: probe decides VA-API use; falls back to software; no per-codec query for apps
Linux dma-buf instead of IOSurface; the shell GPU path imports NV12 directly

features.apple: VTCompressionSessionCreate, VTCompressionSessionEncodeFrame, output callback, PrepareToEncodeFrames, CompleteFrames
features.note: no encoder in springboard/src, springboard/render or springboard/sdk; the only recording path is audio (springboard/src/svc.rs Record)
libavcodec options are set internally in ffmpeg.rs with no property API

features.bifrost: springboard/src/media/convert.rs (nv12_to_rgba, dma_to_rgba, rgba_scale), springboard/src/gpu/nv12.rs (BT.709 / BT.601 matrix)
features.note: conversion exists for the shell's own video path only; no app-facing pixel transfer session

features.bifrost: springboard/render/src/gfx/rotate.rs (90/180 degree rotation of damaged areas for the display, not video buffers)
features.note: display rotation only; not exposed as a video-buffer rotation API
no camera-native or Bayer path in springboard/src/media; v4l2.rs converts only YUV formats it lists
decoder path is 8-bit NV12 only; no 10-bit or HDR transfer handling found

same conversion to the shell's own image type, not to CGImage

features.note: codec set is fixed in the Codec enum (springboard/src/media/mod.rs line 101); no plug-in registration
errors surface as io::Error, not VT status codes

gaps: Video encoding: no compression session, encoder list or encode path (only audio recording exists)
An app-facing video decode API: the decoder is internal to the media stack and not in springboard/sdk
10-bit and HDR decode, HDR metadata generation and log transfer functions
Pixel transfer and rotation as SDK sessions for app pixel buffers
Frame processing: super resolution, frame interpolation, optical flow, motion blur, noise filter and motion estimation
Multi-pass encoding storage (frame silo, multipass storage)
